requirements.name: go-stdlib-only
requirements.text: Implement in Go 1.22 or newer using only the standard library.

requirements.name: executable-main-package
requirements.text: The application root is a Go module, and its executable is the main package at `./cmd/dupfind`.

requirements.name: walk-regular-files
requirements.text: The tool walks `<directory>` recursively, including hidden files and directories (names beginning `.`). It considers regular files only. It neither follows nor reports symbolic links.

requirements.name: skip-empty-files
requirements.text: A file of zero bytes is always ignored, which the default `--min-size 1` guarantees.

requirements.name: min-size-filter
requirements.text: Ignore files smaller than `<bytes>`. A positive integer; default `1`.

requirements.name: group-duplicates
requirements.text: Files are grouped by size first. Only files that share a size are read. Within a size, files are grouped by the SHA-256 digest of their contents. A group of two or more files with the same size and digest is a duplicate group.

requirements.name: options-before-directory
requirements.text: Options precede the directory. Exactly one directory is required.

requirements.name: select-summary-output
requirements.text: Write the summary instead of the listing.

requirements.name: csv-output
requirements.text: Output is CSV on standard output: a header row, then data rows, with `\n` line endings. A field that contains a comma, a double quote, or a newline is quoted as RFC 4180 specifies. Go's `encoding/csv` writer produces this format.

requirements.name: list-one-row-per-file
requirements.text: **Listing** (default): header `group,size,sha256,path`, then one row per file in every duplicate group. `sha256` is the lowercase hexadecimal digest.

requirements.name: list-header-only-when-no-duplicates
requirements.text: With no duplicates, only the header is written.

requirements.name: summary-totals
requirements.text: **Summary** (`--summary`): header `groups,duplicate_files,reclaimable_bytes`, then one row. `duplicate_files` is the sum of `files − 1` over all groups. `reclaimable_bytes` is the sum of every group's reclaimable bytes. With no duplicates the row is `0,0,0`.

requirements.name: group-order
requirements.text: Groups are ordered by reclaimable bytes descending, then by digest ascending. A group's reclaimable bytes are `size × (files − 1)`. Groups are numbered from 1 in that order.

requirements.name: path-order
requirements.text: Within a group, paths are ordered by byte value ascending.

requirements.name: relative-paths
requirements.text: Paths are written relative to `<directory>`, with `/` as the separator and no leading `./`.

requirements.name: skip-unreadable
requirements.text: A file that cannot be read is skipped with one warning line on standard error. It does not change the exit code.

requirements.name: exit-code-zero
requirements.text: `0` | Success, whether or not duplicates were found.

requirements.name: exit-code-one
requirements.text: `1` | Operational failure: `<directory>` does not exist or is not a directory.

requirements.name: exit-code-two
requirements.text: `2` | Usage error: missing or extra arguments, unknown option, `--min-size` not a positive integer.

requirements.name: report-failure-on-stderr
requirements.text: A failing command writes nothing to standard output and one diagnostic line to standard error.

requirements.name: posix-test-gate
requirements.text: The completed application provides a POSIX-compatible `bin/test.sh` that runs `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` from the application root and exits zero only when both pass.

requirements.name: test-coverage
requirements.text: The suite covers each rule, each output form, and each exit code against real temporary directories.

requirements.name: build-go-executable
requirements.text: The deliverable is a Go module whose main package is ./cmd/dupfind.

requirements.name: list-duplicate-files
requirements.text:
group,size,sha256,path
1,1000,950f88b09cf1d5e2cdbc5660c77dce3962265c548797950095629a0ea2daea46,big/blob-a.bin

requirements.name: exclude-zero-byte-and-symlink-entries
requirements.text:
: > "$T/empty/one"
ln -s ../a/report.txt "$T/notes/report-link.txt"

requirements.name: min-size-filter
requirements.text: check C3 0 --min-size 200 tree <<'EOF'

requirements.name: summary-totals
requirements.text:
check B1 0 --summary tree <<'EOF'
groups,duplicate_files,reclaimable_bytes

requirements.name: empty-result-header-only
requirements.text:
check D1 0 tree/unique <<'EOF'
group,size,sha256,path

requirements.name: reject-missing-or-non-directory-target
requirements.text:
check E1 1 tree/no-such-directory < /dev/null
check E2 1 tree/env.bak < /dev/null

requirements.name: reject-invalid-usage
requirements.text: check U3 2 --min-size abc tree < /dev/null
